title: review git-overview jj/git support: verify time, ahead/behind counts, consider test repos
description: Fresh review of the jj support added to git-overview. Check: 1) timestamps show correctly for both jj and git repos, 2) ahead/behind counts are accurate (jj uses trunk()..@ ~ empty() and remote bookmark queries, git uses @{upstream}), 3) consider creating a test/ folder with fixture repos (bare git, git with stash, jj colocated) to make this verifiable without depending on ~/sites. Run the script against ~/sites and spot-check arbe, hus, skrivebord manually.
